text:
anika: FYI — I'm rolling out a tokenizer ABI canary for the onboarding pipeline. want to exercise bench/golden mismatch risk without blowing budget.
kevin: sounds reasonable. do we have a sampling + gating plan yet?
anika: short version: 0.1% of ingests for the canary, stratified by seq_len + language, ~500 samples total. prebench on the canary subset, plus runtime smoke.
matt: how do we define a fail? token edits vs semantic drop — need clear gates.
anika: agreed. proposed gates: if golden-set eval metric (rerank/nll) regresses > 2% absolute OR token-level mismatch on golden inputs > 1% -> fail and auto-fallback. also flag large tokenization shifts for manual review.
sara: paste the sampling config pls
anika: here's the initial sampling config we intend to use:
```json
{
  "canary_frac": 0.001,
  "sample_size": 500,
  "strata": [
    {"name": "short", "seq_max": 32, "pct": 0.35},
    {"name": "mid", "seq_min": 33, "seq_max": 256, "pct": 0.45},
    {"name": "long", "seq_min": 257, "pct": 0.20}
  ],
  "langs": ["en", "es", "jp", "mixed"],
  "golden_overlap": 0.25
}
```
devon: we should simulate KV-cache impact too — small token shifts can change prefix keys and tank hit rates. add a cache-hit check.
anika: yep — added cache hit simulation. if cache_hit_rate drops by >5 percentage points vs baseline, mark as high risk.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: branch tokenizer/abi-canary -> intake-canary-pool at 2026-03-20T09:00Z :rocket:
kevin: add telemetry tags: sample_id, bucket, tokenizer_version, cache_hit_rate, golden_mismatch, model_id. want those in the console.
matt: rollback story? if canary fails we need immediate revert + ensure queued ingests don't use new ABI.
anika: rollout policy: canary -> evaluate -> if gates fail, auto-fallback to previous tokenizer ABI + requeue model admission for manual triage. full revert rollouts are supported at the gateway.
devon: please also add a tiny runtime smoke that runs a few model calls end-to-end (not just bench) — catches segfaults/crashes.
sara: i'll own the dashboard and alerts for the run, will send a short playbook in #eng-ml when it starts. :thumbsup:
kevin: :eyes: i'll monitor telemetry and help distinguish noise vs real regressions.
matt: thanks team — ping me if anything blocks the deploy, especially around cache sim data formats. :party_parrot:
